Penang (George Town)

Malaysia — a whole city, district by district, sourced

6 places · 3 sights · 3 to eat & drink · 1 areas · 10 sources · status last checked 2026-09-02

Penang

Penang 6

George Town

  1. Must see · Wok Noodles (Char Kway Teow, Hokkien Mee, Bak Chor Mee) · Penang

    Penang Road Famous Jin Kor Char Kuey Teow

    ~40-year charcoal stall in the Penang Road cendol lane; MICHELIN Guide-listed for its cockle-and-prawn char koay teow with pronounced wok hei.

    Lebuh Keng Kwee (off Jalan Penang), George Town, Penang, Malaysia

    Recommended by Michelin Guide, Eatbook.sg, Visit Penang (Penang Global Tourism)

  2. Must see · Laksa & Curry Noodles · Penang

    Air Itam Laksa

    The definitive Air Itam asam laksa; CNN Travel ranked Penang asam laksa among the World's 50 Best Foods. Reopened after a pandemic pause; now weekends only.

    Beside Air Itam Market, Jalan Pasar, Air Itam, Penang, Malaysia

    Recommended by The Star, Seth Lui, Visit Penang (Penang Global Tourism)

  3. Must see · Penang

    George Town UNESCO Heritage Zone

    The UNESCO-listed old town of clan jetties, shophouses, temples and the famous street-art murals (part of 'Melaka and George Town, Historic Cities of the Straits of Malacca').

    Look for UNESCO heritage city

    George Town, Penang, Malaysia

    Recommended by UNESCO World Heritage, Wikipedia

  4. Must see · Indian & Roti Prata · Penang

    Nasi Kandar Line Clear

    Penang's most legendary 24-hour nasi kandar, cooked in a narrow lane since the 1940s; the 'flooded' curry-mix rice and fried chicken are institutions.

    177 Jalan Penang (alley at Lebuh Chulia junction), George Town, Penang, Malaysia

    Recommended by Penang Foodie, Malay Mail

  5. Worth the detour · Penang

    Kek Lok Si Temple

    Southeast Asia's largest Chinese Buddhist temple, with the Pagoda of Ten Thousand Buddhas and a 30 m bronze Kuan Yin.

    Look for Buddhist temple

    Air Itam, Penang, Malaysia

    Recommended by Visit Penang (Penang Global Tourism), Wikipedia

  6. Worth the detour · Penang

    Cheong Fatt Tze — The Blue Mansion

    The indigo-blue Hakka merchant mansion, a multi-award-winning heritage restoration and film location ('Crazy Rich Asians').

    Look for Heritage mansion

    14 Leith Street, George Town, Penang, Malaysia

    Recommended by Cuisine Wat Damnak (official), Wikipedia
